how: We read the website of every Portland wedding florist listed on Lazo (179 listings, 137 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: venues and orchards listed as florists, a makeup artist, a delivery shop whose site leads with dove releases and teddy bears, u-pick farms, and flower farms that only sell stems by the bucket. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: What is locally grown in my month? Peak season here is June through September and several of these florists farm their own stems.
Is this design for the venue with installation and teardown, or arrangements delivered, and what does each cost?
Can I see a full wedding's florals at a budget like mine, not just a bouquet photo?

picks.name: Lucy's Informal Flowers
picks.blurb: Lucy came to the Gorge from fashion design, where her specialty was color combinations and forecasting, and got hooked when someone asked her to put a flower on a cake. Lucy's Informal Flowers has done wedding and celebration florals in Hood River since 2005, alongside a flower subscription service.

picks.name: Momo Flower Farm
picks.blurb: A small regenerative flower farm and farmer-florist studio in Southwest Washington serving weddings across the Portland and Vancouver metro. MoMo grows the flowers it designs with, specializes in seasonal, climate-conscious work, and publishes starting prices for custom design.

picks.name: Blum Design In Flowers
tags: Oregon Bride Best of Bride, six times
picks.blurb: Classic, garden-inspired wedding flowers in Portland since 2005. Blum's work has appeared in Oregon Bride, The Oregonian, Sunset and Gourmet, and peers have voted it best florist in Portland six times in Oregon Bride's Best of Bride Awards.

picks.name: Mountain View Floral Design
picks.blurb: Brittany's Mt. Hood studio specializes in weddings around Mt. Hood and Hood River in a timeless, garden style. Mountain View Floral Design does not believe in one-size-fits-all pricing and starts by learning what matters most to each couple.

picks.name: Amanda Karam Floral co.
picks.blurb: A full-service wedding and event florist designing stylish, modern and romantic weddings in Portland since 2010. Amanda designs out of a studio in the heart of the city and describes lush pieces built from carefully curated flowers.

picks.name: Trellis Florals
picks.blurb: Blaire grew up working in a flower shop, earned an interior design degree and runs Trellis Florals in the Columbia River Gorge with an eco-friendly bent. The site lists elopement packages, a bridal bouquet, boutonniere and a vase of loose flowers, with pick-up pricing.

picks.name: Starflower
picks.blurb: Jill founded Starflower in 2001 with a focus on boutique weddings and has more than 20 years as a designer and shop owner. Known for natural arrangements and installations with locally sourced flowers, the shop also does elopements, same-day delivery and classes.

picks.name: Petalcalyptus Floral Design
picks.blurb: Natural, romantic, garden-inspired arrangements from seasonal blooms, locally grown whenever possible. Petalcalyptus does weddings and elopements in Portland and says every wedding, big or small, deserves good florals.

picks.name: Lavande Bloom
picks.blurb: Donna, originally from Ukraine, began with flowers 17 years ago in a small retail shop and later earned certification at the Floral Design Institute. Lavande Bloom designs custom wedding florals and explains on its site how event size, blooms, installations and table count drive the price.

picks.name: Geranium Lake Flowers
picks.blurb: Owner Kim Foren trained as a fine art painter and named the studio after a Winsor and Newton oil color. Geranium Lake is a full-service flower shop and event designer in Portland with a stated expertise in cultural weddings and destination Portland weddings.

picks.name: Farmhouse Floral & Gifts
picks.blurb: Jennifer McDonald, a Portland native who married her high school sweetheart at 17, designs wedding and event flowers from a five-acre farm in Vancouver, Washington where some of the flowers are grown. Consultations are free.

picks.name: Lush Floral Design
picks.blurb: Wendy's Lush Floral Design works exclusively on weddings and events. A Pacific Northwest native, she began nearly 20 years ago designing for family and friends, studied at the Floral Design Institute in Portland and worked in a downtown shop before opening her own studio.
